### Summary
Brief description of the bug.

### Pre-conditions
- User is on `https://www.saucedemo.com/`

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to the login page.
2. Leave the username field blank.
3. Click the "Login" button.

### Expected Result
An error banner stating "Username is required" should appear.

### Actual Result
No error banner appears, page freezes.

### Severity & Priority
- **Severity:** High
- **Priority:** P1

### Environment
- **Browser:** Chrome v128
- **OS:** Windows 11
